name: ico_footsteps
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone game HUD pictogram: a pair of small staggered footprints meaning moves. Match the provided Perch Sort icon sheet's colored cartoon pictograms exactly: leaf-green fill, subtle warm highlights, smooth dark-brown outline equivalent to 3 px on a final 128x128 icon. Two clear footprints only, no feather, no numbers or text, no button or frame. Center within a square transparent canvas with modest padding. Clear silhouette readable at 64 and 28 pixels. True transparent RGBA background.
